title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.16402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. translated_title: EvoWeb：一个针对不断演化的Web应用的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: Web应用开发通常是通过一系列连续的请求来扩展现有实现的过程。然而，现有的网页生成基准主要评估面向固定规格的开发。我们提出了EvoWeb，这是一个新颖的基准测试，包含32个Web应用上的320个累积请求，基于真实世界的产品功能，并由功能依赖图进行结构化组织。智能体迭代地修改一个持久化的代码库，同时一个多模态网页智能体在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，评估新请求的功能、跨请求的集成以及先前已请求的功能。为了刻画整个开发过程中的可靠性，我们整合了跨用户容忍阈值的轨迹性能表现，而不是强加固定的停止标准。在开源和闭源前沿模型上的实验表明，EvoWeb揭示了模型之间明显的性能差异，其中跨请求的集成（原文在此截断）
tldr: EvoWeb是一个评估编码智能体在持续演化的Web应用开发中能力的基准测试，通过320个累积请求、功能依赖图结构和实时浏览器多模态测试，来衡量模型在实现新功能、跨请求集成以及维护既有功能方面的表现。
en_tdlr: EvoWeb is a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on evolving web application development, using 320 cumulative requests structured by functional dependency graphs and live-browser multimodal testing to assess new functionality, cross-request integration, and retention of previously implemented features.
